Container.Name: Cruncharr-Test
Container.Overview: BLEEDING-EDGE TEST CHANNEL of Cruncharr — tracks the testing branch and updates ahead of the stable release. Expect occasional bugs; use the regular Cruncharr template for the stable channel. Cruncharr is a self-hosted companion for keeping your personal anime media library organized: an *arr-style web interface with catalog and library tracking, a release calendar, activity history, and Sonarr integration. Multi-architecture image (amd64 and arm64). Set PUID/PGID to match the owner of your appdata and media shares so the container can write to them.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: anime media library catalog sonarr arr beta testing
Container.Requires: Internet access and an account with your source service. Some sources may require the matching device files to be placed in the /widevine path.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: HTTP port for the Cruncharr web interface.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Stores settings, catalog, activity history and logs. Use a separate appdata path from the stable container if you run both.

Config.Name: Media
Config.Description: Where your library files are written and organized.

Config.Name: Device Files
Config.Description: Optional path for source device files, if your source requires them.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the container runs as. Match the owner of your config and media shares.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the container runs as.

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: Permission mask for new files. 002 creates group-writable files/directories so Sonarr can rename and import them when it shares PGID.

Config.Name: API Key (optional)
Config.Description: Optional: require this key to access the interface. Leave blank to disable.

Config.Name: Account Email (optional)
Config.Description: Optional: pre-fill your source account email. Can also be set in the web interface.

Config.Name: Account Password (optional)
Config.Description: Optional: pre-fill your source account password. Can also be set in the web interface.
